shots.name: s01_hook_developer
shots.video_prompt: Wide shot of a dark anime developer's room at night, single hooded figure at a desk silhouetted by the cold blue light of three monitors, glowing yellow R logo on the center monitor reflected in his round glasses, slow push-in, continuous subtle motion, 90s cel-shaded anime style, Akira lighting, dramatic shadows, 9:16 vertical
shots.vo_text: What if your scroll could build things?
shots.subtitle: What if your scroll could build things?

shots.name: s02_feed_likes
shots.video_prompt: Cinematic anime shot of a vertical video feed scrolling on a smartphone in a dark room, three stacked video previews, glowing yellow heart-shaped pulses streaming out of each video and flying upward like fireflies, deep blue background, dramatic neon glow, continuous flowing motion, 90s cel-shaded anime style, Ghost in the Shell atmosphere, 9:16 vertical
shots.vo_text: Rally is a feed where every like programs an AI agent.
shots.subtitle: Every like programs an AI agent.

shots.name: s03_signal_swarm
shots.video_prompt: Anime cinematic shot of a swarm of glowing yellow light particles flowing through dark space, converging on a single luminous figure standing at a holographic console, dramatic concentration of energy, particles arc gracefully into a single point, continuous purposeful motion, 90s cel-shaded anime style, dramatic shadows, 9:16 vertical
shots.vo_text: The more people care, the more agents focus.
shots.subtitle: More care = more agents.

shots.name: s04_agent_works
shots.video_prompt: Cinematic anime medium shot of a stylized AI agent figure assembling glowing yellow code blocks at a holographic terminal, hands moving rapidly, sparks of light flying, dark studio environment with red warning indicators in the background, continuous purposeful motion, 90s cel-shaded anime style, dramatic shadows, 9:16 vertical
shots.vo_text: Real code. Real pull requests. Real work.
shots.subtitle: Real code. Real PRs. Real work.

shots.name: s05_proof_card
shots.video_prompt: Bold geometric proof card on pure pitch black background, large bright yellow sans-serif text RALLY at upper third of frame, smaller yellow text rallysignal.co stacked beneath it, smaller still text at-rallysignal at the bottom. Slow continuous push-in zoom toward the text the entire shot. Bright vertical scan lines flicker and pulse rapidly across the whole frame. A golden horizontal lens flare drifts left to right across the middle. Tiny yellow particle dust floats slowly upward in the negative space. Continuous obvious motion throughout, never static. 90s anime cel-shaded style, dramatic atmospheric lighting, 9:16 vertical.
shots.vo_text: Rally is open source. Link in bio.
shots.subtitle: rallysignal.co · @rallysignal

shots.name: s06_payoff_city
shots.video_prompt: Anime cinematic wide shot of a futuristic city skyline at dusk, a massive yellow R banner unfurling over the rooftops glowing against the orange and purple sky, city lights twinkling below, slow upward camera tilt revealing more of the banner, continuous motion, 90s cel-shaded anime style, dramatic atmospheric lighting, 9:16 vertical
shots.vo_text: Your engagement is now a programming language.
shots.subtitle: Your engagement is now a programming language.
